name: Kecak Machine
desc: FUSES the Balinese kecak chant grid (vox.gamelan.kecak - clipped ades shouts) with warehouse techno's relentless 16th lock (drums.techno.warehouse world): interlocking chak-chak-chak rows filtered and pumped like a synth stab.

code.full: stack(s("{ades2 ades2 ades2 ades2}%8").end(.2).speed(${pitch}), s("{~ ades3 ~ ades3 ~ ades3}%8").end(.22).speed(${pitch}*1.15).gain(.8), s("ades4").euclid(5,16).end(.25).speed(${pitch}*.9).gain(.85)).shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.68,${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.38,.62).slow(12)).room(.2).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: stack(s("{ades2 ades2 ades2 ades2 ades2}%16").end(.16).speed(${pitch}), s("{~ ades3 ades3 ~ ades3}%16").end(.18).speed(${pitch}*1.2).gain(.8), s("ades4").euclid(7,16).end(.22).speed(${pitch}*.85).gain(.9)).shape(.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8,${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.32,.68).slow(8)).every(4, x=>x.rev()).room(.15).orbit(8).play()
